target: Final verification gate for the cost-profile redesign series. Runs the full RTE regression suite, the promptset v3 audit, a bounded-lane dry-run (Phase A step A2 with --cost-profile value-default --print-config), and a pal/codereview + pal/precommit pass over the cumulative diff E1..E9. Produces a single PROOF bundle that signs off the series as ready for live operator use.
invariants: Do not modify any production code in this packet. Verification only.
If verification fails, file a follow-up TP rather than 'fixing in place' — preserves the audit-trail boundary between implementation packets and the verification gate.
The bounded-lane dry-run must NOT use --execute (we're verifying config resolution, not running LLMs). RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 stays set.
PAL chain MUST include analyze + thinkdeep + challenge + codereview + precommit + challenge (the long form, because this is the series-final gate).

Verification proof must record exact git SHAs of each contributing packet's merge commit and the cumulative diff range so a future operator can reproduce the verification at the same point in history.
Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.

pr.title: verify(rte): cost-profile redesign series final verification (F)
pr.body:
## Summary
- Series-final verification for the RTE cost-profile redesign (E1..E9).
- Runs the full RTE test suite + promptset v3 audit + bounded-lane dry-run + pal/codereview + pal/precommit and captures all outputs as durable proof.
- Produces SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md attesting that the series is ready for live operator use.

## Scope
Verification-only. No production code changes. Proof bundle is the deliverable.

## Validation
Full test suite green; promptset audit returns 0 lint failures; --cost-profile value-default --print-config produces a populated ladder with resolved model IDs; pal/codereview reports no critical issues across the cumulative diff; pal/precommit returns SAFE TO COMMIT.

## NOT_RUN
- Live LLM execution (operator's call after this packet merges; bounded-lane dry-run only here).
- Cross-pipeline integration with the v3-pipeline (separate authority).

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- xAI batch support unverified (separate TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-XAI-BATCH-VERIFY-001 covers).
- Post-step output validators for control_plane / security_sensitive steps deferred (separate TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-OUTPUT-VALIDATORS-001 covers).

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight: verify all 5 prerequisite packets (E3, E4-FINISH, E7, E8, E9) merged. Capture each merge commit SHA. Verify worktree clean and on a fresh branch from origin/main post-E9 merge.
validation: All 5 packet merge SHAs captured.
Verification branch based on the post-E9 origin/main.

steps.task: Run the full RTE test suite under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1. Capture stdout/stderr to pytest_full_run.txt.
validation: Pytest exit code 0 (all pass) OR explicit per-failure analysis in SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md (pre-existing failures from main are tolerated if traceable to git blame on main, not these changes).
Total test count > 800 (sanity check on collection).

steps.task: Run the promptset v3 audit against the new model_map.yaml v3. Capture output. The audit must verify: impact_class enforcement (structural/security_sensitive ⇒ critical tier); tag enum membership (only the 8 allowed); tag_rationale presence for every tagged step; override count <= 15 (warn at 12).
commands: dopemux rte promptset audit --pipeline-version v4 --no-strict 2>&1 | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-001/promptset_audit_v3.txt
validation: Audit reports 0 lint failures.
Override count is 6 (the consensus-mandated set: Z0/C10/S12/T0/T1/T3).

steps.task: Run the bounded-lane dry run: `python services/repo-truth-extractor/run_extraction_v5.py --phase A --step A2 --cost-profile value-default --print-config`. Capture output. Verify the resolved ladder for (CE, medium) shows the consensus-mandated OR-primary path, that service_tier defaults match the profile, that disabled_providers is empty (none specified), and that model_alias_overrides is empty.
validation: --print-config exits 0.
Output contains 'cost_profile: value-default'.
Output contains 'openrouter/openai/gpt-5.3-codex' as the primary route for an A0/A1-class step (CE/medium).
Output does NOT contain any legacy `BALANCED_GROK_OPENROUTER_*` constant references (those are deprecated by E7).

steps.task: Run pal/codereview over the cumulative diff range (E1 base..origin/main post-E9). Capture output.
validation: pal/codereview reports no critical issues OR all critical issues are explicitly addressed in subsequent packets in this series.
Findings classified by severity in SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.

steps.task: Run pal/precommit on the verification branch (cumulative work). Capture output.
validation: pal/precommit returns SAFE TO COMMIT or only-info-level findings.

steps.task: Author SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md: summary of what was verified, packet-by-packet SHAs, test counts (pass/fail/skip), promptset audit results, bounded-lane dry-run summary, pal/codereview verdict, pal/precommit verdict, residual risks, recommended operator next steps (i.e. now safe to run --cost-profile value-default --execute on a bounded lane with --max-cost-usd cap).
validation: Report explicitly states VERIFIED or NOT_VERIFIED.
If NOT_VERIFIED, names the follow-up TP needed.

steps.task: Emit PROOF.json + sha256sums.txt referencing all the captured artifacts.
validation: PROOF.json parses.
sha256sums.txt verifies all .txt + .md proof files.

steps.task: Commit allowlisted files; push; open PR (no code change PR; verification proof bundle only).
validation: PR title clearly marks 'verify(rte)' scope.
PR body links the SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md.

steps.task: Update task-packets/INDEX.md to mark all 6 packets in this series as 'Merged' (or 'Verified' for this packet). Update related-ADR column to point to docs/90-adr/rte-cost-profiles-and-optimizer-wiring.md.
validation: INDEX.md committed in this same PR.
All 6 packets visible with status updated.
